title: Theta graphs with a three-edge path are e-positive
description: Unrefereed written-proof candidate: theta(a,b,3) is e-positive for every a>=b>=3. The proof builds on Chen, He and Wang’s composition expansion and partial-reversal method; the contribution is c=3 negative-set and full weighted-fibre accounting, with an analytic zero-group classification. Exact finite tests through 24 vertices are internal checks, not a proof of the universal quantifier, formal verification or external peer review. General shortest path at least four remains open here.
